institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Vitamin A deficiency and malnutrition in women and children.
description: A cost-effective process to produce Red Palmolein (RPO) as a functional food source of Vitamin A and Vitamin E. The process involves neutralization, winterization, filtration, and low-temperature vacuum deodorization of crude palm oil, utilized as a dietary approach through blended oil.
applications: Production of fortified edible blended cooking oils , Manufacturing of nutritional supplements combating vitamin deficiencies,Formulation of nutrient-dense ingredients for public food programs , Processing of high-carotene functional food oil bases
